It cuts with surgical precision.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (10 Total) and applies the effect of EMP Ammunition, but only disables 1 piece of the victim’s Cyberware. If the user has an active Sandevistan, this weapon provides a +1 bonus to Aimed Shots, and when rolling for its damage (on any Attack), 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. If damage dealt by this weapon would reduce a target to under 1 HP, the user can choose to leave their target Unconscious at 1 HP instead.

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
